name: identity
title: Identity
description: A person as one glance: avatar beside name and secondary line — the face next to the name, never a face floating a row above it. Consolidated from the showcase's and a second product's hand-rolled identity blocks. Copy: the name as the person writes it, and the secondary line is what they do here, not their whole title. Two lines, both short: this is a face with a name, not a profile.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Identity.json
